name: std::bitset<N>::reset
intro:
Sets bits to false.

1) Sets all bits to false

2) Sets the bit at position pos to false.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
pos

 -

 the position of the bit to set

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: 2) Throws std::out_of_range if pos does not correspond to a valid bit position.
